identificationModule.briefTitle: Steroid Sparing Regimen With Olanzapine and Palonosetron for Emetic Prevention for High Dose Cisplatin
identificationModule.officialTitle: Steroid-sparing Regimen With Olanzapine and Ondansetron to Prevent Emesis Caused by High Dose Cisplatin in Solid Cancer Patient : A Single Arm Phase II Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A phase II study evaluating dexamethasone sparing regimen with olanzapine and palonosetron for patients receiving high dose cisplatin to prevent chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting

armGroups.label: study arm
armGroups.description: olanzapine palonosetron with dexamethasone on day 1 only

primaryOutcomes.description: no vomiting and no rescue therapy

secondaryOutcomes.description: additional treatment for nausea or vomiting

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically confirmed solid malignancy
* scheduled for first cycle of cisplatin at dosage of at least 50 mg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* pelvic or abdominal radiation within 4 weeks
* uncontrolled brain metastasis
* other moderate or high emetic risk chemotherapy on day 2-5
* untreated gut obstruction
* known allergy or severe adverse effect from palonosetron or olanzapine
* AST/ ALT \> 2.5x or serum creatinine clearance less than 50 ml/min
